test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following concluded his tenure as the 50 Chief Justice of India in November 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Justice DY Chandrachud**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice DY Chandrachud** served as the 50th **Chief Justice of India (CJI)**.
 
• He succeeded **Justice Uday Umesh Lalit** as the Chief Justice of India.
 
• Justice Chandrachud is known for his significant judgments on **constitutional law, human rights, and gender justice**.
 
• He has a strong educational background with degrees from **Harvard University**.
 
• Justice Chandrachud has also served as the Chief Justice of the **Allahabad High Court** before being elevated to the Supreme Court of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Justice Abhay S Oka**__

 __
 
• **Justice Abhay S Oka** is a judge of the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
• He previously served as the Chief Justice of the **Karnataka High Court**.
 
• Justice Oka is known for his judicial pronouncements on **public interest litigations (PILs)** and **human rights**.
 
 
 
• **Justice Surya Kant**__
 __
 
• **Justice Surya Kant** is a sitting judge of the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
• He has previously served as the Chief Justice of the **Himachal Pradesh High Court**.
 
• Justice Surya Kant is known for his work in the field of **environmental law** and **administrative law**.
 
 
 
• **Justice Sanjeev Khanna**__
 
 
• **Justice Sanjeev Khanna** is a judge of the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
• He was elevated from the **Delhi High Court**.
 
• Justice Khanna has delivered important judgments on **corporate law** and **commercial disputes**.
